hypotheses.R1_rank16_captures_gram_energy: Rank 16 captures at least 90% of median exact Fisher-Gram energy on both corpora.
hypotheses.R2_rank16_recovers_finite_effect: Rank-16 finite intervention reaches median Fisher fidelity at least 0.90 to the full-Gram program on both corpora.
hypotheses.R3_rank16_recovers_objective: Rank 16 reaches at least 90% of the full-Gram objective on both corpora.
hypotheses.R4_rank32_recovers_support: Rank 32 recovers at least 75% of full-Gram top-16 mode support on both corpora.
hypotheses.R5_rank32_recovers_magnitude: Rank-32 exact KL is at least 90% of full-Gram exact KL on both corpora.
hypotheses.R6_compact_rank_is_ood_stable: Rank-32 finite-effect fidelity drops by at most 0.05 from FineWeb to WikiText.
